newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai copper tube maker sets IPO at 45 baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai copper tube maker sets IPO at 45 baht.

text.p: Furukawa Metal (Thailand) Plc on Thursday set a 45 baht ($1.8) initial public offer for each of its 14.5 million new common shares.
Furukawa Metal produces seamless copper tubes, a refrigerator and air-conditioner part. Its shares are open for public subscription on November 11-13.

It said 7.4 million of shares being floated will be offered to foreign investors with the rest set aside for local buyers. Capital Nomura Securities Plc and Thana One Finance and Securities Co Ltd were mandated as lead underwriters for the issue.

Furukawa Metal said it expects to post a 219 million baht net profit in 1996 against 132 million in 1995. The company said it netted about 150 million baht after tax earnings in the first half of this year.
